wa_lost_warriors.notes: OVERLAPS (as asked): P1 is the first pitch of Young Warriors (wa_young_warriors), and the last pitch climbs the upper Southeast Corner ramp shared with the SE Face route and Young Warriors' finish, so the route shares its first and last pitches with Young Warriors. Mountain Project's Whit's Wall page says Whit's Wall meets Lost Warriors at one belay stance. A bail anchor up and right of P3 reaches the Boardwalk P1 anchor with two ropes. Catalog defect: the fa string mixes the FA party with the FFA ('FFA-Joseph Healy, Karsten Duncan') and the ffa column is empty; reported, not rewritten (one source). MP says all anchors are large Metolius hangers (no anchor value proposed for a multi-pitch). MP rates the protection R and Grade III; prot_rating and commitment not proposed (one source). The bonsai-tree belay at the top of P5 blew down in March 2010.
